fields.text: Make a five-second locked-camera product clip: Muse draws the first frame ($0.01), MiniMax H3 Spicy animates one small movement (480p, $0.20). This model supports image-to-video; the scene is a simple product still. Change the still and motion briefs together. Inspect temporal stability; a seamless loop is not guaranteed.

A compact matte-charcoal pocket night-ride radio resting on rain-slick wet asphalt. One sharp lightning-bolt chevron in electric cyan on the faceplate. Cyan edge light from camera-right, deep night-city bokeh behind, close three-quarter view, entire radio visible, clear chevron silhouette, no text or logos.

Locked camera for five seconds. Fine rain streaks fall slowly through the cyan edge light and shimmer on the wet asphalt. The radio remains completely still. Preserve its shape and placement; no cuts, new objects or camera motion.
